name: Nem nuong
summary: Named by Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định on 2 May 2019 among the night snacks on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. A recipe was not printed. It is not nem chợ huyện.
origin: Those two streets in Quy Nhon, on the 2 May 2019 article from Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định.
howToEat: The piece calls it walking food at night and does not describe a wrap. Check on arrival.
where: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. Numbers 185–187 Phan Bội Châu are the tourism office, not a stall.
